description: Every file the base (Cursor-supporting) installers wrote under ~/.cursor/hooks/toolstack, and the global rules install-body.sh synced into ~/.cursor/rules. Derived from the file trees of scripts/lib/global-toolstack, scripts/lib/recommended-tools and scripts/lib/five_tool_runtime at claude/optimistic-ramanujan-tccfud 49089fa2, following scripts/install-global-toolstack.sh (copies every *.sh/*.py of global-toolstack, common.sh to lib/, install-body.sh to install.sh, global-recommended-tools.mdc, sb_host_config.py, the five_tool_runtime/*.py), scripts/lib/recommended-tools/installer.sh (rt_deploy_toolstack_scripts: the .ts adapters; rt_deploy_reconciler_snapshots: reconcile-recommended-tools.sh and every file of lib/recommended-tools) and scripts/lib/global-toolstack/install-body.sh (ts_global_rule). The cleanup must move every one of them.

global_rules.agentmemory: agentmemory session capture and Graphify synergy
global_rules.leanctx: LeanCTX routing rules for SB five-tool parallel stack
global_rules.context-mode: context-mode routing rules for context window protection
global_rules.token-compression-enforcement: Global RTK + Context Mode enforcement — hard requirements for all Cursor workspaces
global_rules.recommended-tools: Global recommended tools — five_tool_routed stack (always enforced)
